meta.name: Perfect Crown
meta.description: In 21st-century Korea under a constitutional monarchy, a chaebol heiress with everything but status tries to take control of her future after crossing paths with a lonely prince with nothing but his title. Together, bound by a contract marriage, they begin a class-defying romance to rewrite destiny.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: After a chance encounter with Grand Prince I-AN, chaebol heiress Seong Huiju schemes to rise higher.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Huiju is pushed to meet with potential suitors. Grand Prince I-AN considers accepting her proposal.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: A secret rendezvous scandal rocks the royal family, and Grand Prince I-AN makes a public statement.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: When Huiju moves into Grand Prince I-AN's residence and proves to be a handful, a conspiracy awaits…

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: As Huiju digs for the truth, Grand Prince I-AN distances himself thinking it is safer to stay away.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: The celebrated pair makes a dazzling return at the banquet, waltzing and professing their fake love.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: With the wedding looming, everyone begins to realize a strange turn in the couple's relationship.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: The 21st-century Grand Prince's wife arrives. Amid cheers and wary eyes, two men make a bold choice.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: Facing a political crisis, the couple choose to fight to protect one another, each in their own way.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: Others step in for the couple who struggle to be honest, and a new era begins to stir at the court.

meta.slogan: A royal deal… that changed everything.
